transcript.text: Hi everyone — the new usage-based billing meter has passed its sandbox integration tests and is targeted for next month's billing cycle. I'll be making the final launch decision, but as part of normal signoff I want to check with each of you before approving the current draft. The draft proposes an immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding on the usage amounts, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review. I'd like to hear any concerns from your areas before I make a call.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While validating an older contract adapter during a separate billing reconciliation task, I confirmed that annual-credit contracts require six-decimal meter precision and half-even rounding to avoid cumulative invoice discrepancies. This finding has not yet been added to the launch checklist, and it directly conflicts with the current draft's two-decimal half-up rounding proposal.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with revenue accounting this morning that the first launch requires invoice previews for exactly 50 accounts and a maximum measured variance of 10 basis points before production billing can be approved. The accounting note is still being attached to the finance ticket.
transcript.speaker: A3
